notes.title: Mythrel v0.8.2
notes.content:
Mythrel v0.8.2 - Happy Halloween! 🎃

Limited Time Content (Only Until Nov 20, 2024)

- 🎃 New Holiday Promo Card: "Cursed Pumpkin" available in the Dragon Scale Bazaar ONLY until [b]November 20th 2024[/b]. This card will be remain tradeable to other players and has no limit per player. You may have up to 4 x Cursed Pumpkins in your deck! It is recommended to play Gauntlet mode to earn Dragon Scales, try Gambit if you feel like taking a risk!

- Backend networking upgrades and engine updates

- Internal improvements to our build pipelines

- Toggle card previews while in a realm match with a new toggle available in the top right of the game screen!

- Google OAuth Login and Registering Mythrel Accounts now available across all platforms including https://codex.mythrel.com


We are excited to be bringing many new updates and cards that improve game mechanics and meta this holiday season! See you in the realms!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.8 - Referrals and Plaques!
notes.content:
[h1]Mythrel v0.5.8 Release Notes [/h1]

✨ Unprecedented Features & Groundbreaking Additions! ✨

 [h3]Audri, The Healer – Dragon Scale Promo![/h3] 

Dive into the Mythrel realms with Audri, The Healer, marking a significant moment as the[b] FIRST-ever digital card you can acquire using Dragon Scales![/b] 🐉

A beacon in our digital collection, Audri's debut not only adds enchantment to a deck but also paves the way for the future.


[h3] Introducing Player Plaque Images[/h3] 

Experience our BRAND NEW feature: [b]21 DISTINCT player plaque images to flex your profile[/b]! Make your Mythrel persona shine! 🌟

Plus: Every plaque sports your unique referral QR code for smooth sharing! Be the talk of the town!


[h3] Referral System: Dive Deeper & Score BIG![/h3] 

[b]Sharing is Rewarding! The Mythrel Referral System is here, and it's PACKED with goodies for both you and your friends.[/b]

Step 1: Share your unique referral code, link, or flaunt your player plaque.

Step 2: Once your friends taste victory with at least three wins in Gauntlet realm matches, both of you pocket a cool [b]100 Dragon Scales[/b]! 🐉

Step 3: The journey continues! When your friend reaches the grandeur of player level three, thanks to twenty wins in Origin/Gambit Realm Matches, you both bask in the glow of[b] three current set booster packs[/b]. 🎁

Share, play, and relish the endless rewards! Login to the Codex to start sharing! https://codex.mythrel.com


[h3]Enhancements & Tweaks [/h3]

Set forth in newly balanced terrains with our updated Vortex and Gauntlet realm decks, updated for riveting gameplay.

For the meticulous – The Codex now boasts a dedicated transfer history in settings.

CALLING ALL DEVS! Our sparkling NEW Mythrel Player API awaits in our Developer API section.

Enjoy blazing speeds as sections like Rankings and Realm Archives on the Codex get a turbocharged performance uplift.


[h3]Refinements & Fixes[/h3]

Your feedback is gold! We've swatted some bugs and sprinkled several upgrades for a fluid Mythrel experience.

📣 Dive into v0.5.8 and explore these electrifying features, as the lore and allure of Mythrel continue to evolve!

Pre-Order Second Edition Booster Boxes, Blister Packs, and Playmats at https://store.mythrel.com with more information at https://codex.mythrel.com/preorder

A toast to our enthusiastic gamers! Your passion lights up Mythrel's realms. 🎮🌌🥳

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.6
notes.content:
[b]Mythrel Trading Card Game v0.5.6 Update is LIVE![/b]

Hello Mythrelians! We're beyond excited to bring you the newly minted v0.5.6 Update! The adventure doesn’t stop here; we have a bevy of new updates and exclusive offers for you.

[b]Buy-A-Box Promos Just Got Hotter![/b]
When you pre-order a Second Edition Booster Box, you'll receive a special "Buy-a-Box" promo card. But guess what? There are FIVE unique designs, and they're randomly inserted for that extra thrill!

[b]Pre-Order Your Second Edition Playmats Now![/b]
Step up your game with our jaw-dropping Second Edition playmats, now available for pre-order. Again, FIVE unique designs await you—each one randomly inserted!

[b]New: Second Edition Blister Packs! [/b]

Unwrap a Blister Pack to find:

[list]
[*] 1 Ward Coin
[*] 1 Second Edition Booster Pack
[*] 1 Exclusive Holo Promo Card (one of FIVE unique, randomly inserted designs!)
[/list]

[b]Revamped Codex: Bigger & Better! [/b]
We’ve given our Codex a major makeover—it’s now more responsive, comes with a sleek new developer API, and boasts a plethora of improvements!

[b]Coming Soon: The Map of Mythrel![/b]
Brace yourselves for an immersive experience with our upcoming Map of Mythrel!
[b]
Highlights of Mythrel v0.5.6[/b]

Improved Codex UI responsiveness
New Developer API
Preorder updates
Bug fixes and quality of life improvements
Inclusion of all new Second Edition promo cards
Card balance updates
Removed unbalanced Vortex deck
Introducing Deck Codes for player-made decks
New calculated ELO average across Vortex, Gauntlet, and Origin ELO ratings
...and much more!

[b]Weekly League Rewards Update[/b]

Weekly League now offers:

[b]5 Second Edition packs
20 Dragon Scales
1 Random Promo from a selection of 14 unique promos![/b]

[b]Also, every time you open 24 Second Edition digital booster packs, you'll get a Buy-a-Box promo as a bonus![/b]

Don’t miss out! Hop back into Mythrel to discover all the new and exciting features.

We’d love to hear from you! If you are an LGS thinking about pre-ordering Second Edition products, please contact us @mythreltcg . Share your thoughts and questions in the comments or join the conversation in our Discord channels!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mythrel v0.5.3 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

Hello, Mythrelians! We've have been hard at work and we're excited to announce the latest changes and improvements in version 0.5.3. Here's what's new in this update:

[b]14 New Second Edition Full Art Rare Cards: [/b]We've introduced a new batch of full art rare cards into the mix. Enhance your decks with these beautifully crafted cards and let the battles commence! These are of regular "Rare" rarity but a beautiful "full art" version of the card.

[b]2 New Second Edition Rare Cards: [/b]Apart from the full art rares, we've also added 2 new rare cards and many other of various rarities! More options for strategic play and deck building! (Expect more Second Edition cards to change before finalization, thank you for your feedback!).

[b]Codex Card Enhancements:[/b] The Codex will now have Mythicals and Exotics with a rainbow effect in 2D to better establish card rarity and type.

[b]Card Sleeve Options:[/b] Personalize your game experience with over [b]17 new card sleeve designs[/b] available in the Dragon Scale Bazaar! You can also use your card sleeves during in-realm matches. Show off your personal style in every match! You can spend Dragon Scales on Card Sleeves to unlock permanently for your account, more will be coming!

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
We've squashed some bugs and made a handful of under-the-hood improvements to enhance game performance and stability.

We'd like to take this opportunity to thank all our players for their continuous support and feedback. As always, we're listening to your suggestions and continuously working to improve your experience in the realm of Mythrel.

Physical product for 1st Edition Kickstarter is shipping this week! Be sure to stream your box openings or join another one and tag us in socials! Pre-Orders will be going live soon for Second Edition!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mythrel v0.5.2 Release Notes[/b][/h1]

Greetings, Mythrel fans! We're excited to bring you the latest update, v0.5.2, that adds a bunch of new features and improvements to enhance your trading card game experience!

[b]New Market Feature: [/b]Now, you can easily list your cards for sale, purchase available listings, or cancel your own on the market at https://codex.mythrel.com. It's a great way to expand your collection and discover new cards!

[b]Performance Improvements: [/b]We've done a significant number of backend updates to improve game performance. These enhancements should make your gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

[b]Card Updates and Additions:[/b] As we move toward the release of the Second Edition, we've [b]updated over 13 cards[/b] for Second Edition early access. But that's not all, we've added two new game balancing cards, the "Revenant Ruler" and "Willow of Withering" - both meticulously designed by the renowned MTG artist [b]Scott Murphy[/b]!

[b]Further Improvements and Future Plans:[/b] As always, we've made a slew of miscellaneous improvements and we have many more in the pipeline. Stay tuned for even more new cards, updated artwork, and features coming in the Second Edition!

As we continue to evolve Mythrel, we welcome and appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your ongoing support, and we can't wait for you to enjoy these latest improvements!

See you in the realms!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.5.1
notes.content:
Mythrel continues to evolve with our newest update, version 0.5.1. This update delivers on balancing changes, improved card artwork, and enhanced user interface features. We've listened to your feedback, and we're excited to share what's new in this release.

[b]Card Balances and Updates[/b]
We've rebalanced and updated numerous cards from our Second Edition. Both stats and artwork updates have been implemented, so make sure to check them out in your collections:

[list]
[*] Demon Horn
[*] Dragon of the Realms
[*] Hunting Wolf
[*] Draconic Dissolution
[*] Wilderness Boar
[*] Elora, Angel Warrior
[*] Calista Mira
[*] Eira
[*] Chalice of the Ages
[*] Drake of the Skies
[*] Sikka, Sobekian Warrior
[*] Miu Archers
[*] Ironpoint Spear
[*] Siofra
[*] Draconic Doom
[*] Miu Summoner
[*] Restraint
[/list]
We've introduced some enhancements to make your Mythrel experience even more enjoyable:

[b]Sorting by Set in Collection & Decks:[/b] To provide a smoother navigation experience, we've added the option to sort your Collection and Decks by set. Whether you're looking for 1st Edition Kickstarter cards, Second Edition cards, or Promotional Cards, you can now find them more easily.

[b]Hide/Show Chat in-realm matches:[/b] We understand that sometimes, you need a distraction-free game. Now you have the option to hide or show chat during in-realm matches. The choice is yours!

[b]Updated Codex navigation:[/b] Exploring the Mythrel Codex has become even more intuitive. On card pages, you can now navigate to the previous or next card in the set with just a click.

[b]More audio: [/b]We have started to add more music and audio to Mythrel for a more immersive experience!

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b]
As with any update, we've implemented minor bug fixes and backend improvements to ensure the smoothest experience possible.

We're committed to continually improving Mythrel. As always, we're looking forward to your feedback and thank you for your continued support! Happy gaming!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.4.4
notes.content:
A completely random player now kicks off the game, regardless of whether they created the realm or not.

You can now report players, bugs, and suggest new features directly from the game, thanks to the new "/reportplayer <username>" command while in-realm chat.

Enjoy the silence with the new "/mute" command. This feature allows you to mute other players via the in-realm chat.

Dragon Scale Bazaar now has a Deactivate button for avatar frames.

Revamped "Realm History" to load much quicker!

Moved some logic functions (including mana-related functions) to the server for smoother gameplay.
Fixed the two deck bug for Origin and Tranquil quick play

Enhanced the input while selecting a card: now, only one card can be selected at a time.

Solved a possible issue where the mana could exceed 10.

Resolved a bug with attacking and ending your turn too quickly, this resolved a multitude of bugs related to this. This should make gameplay overall much less "buggy".

Addressed a problem where times weren't displaying correctly for all regions. This should make the game more accessible for our international players.

Resolved an issue where password input was missing on Gauntlet realm creation.

Fixed a problem with the timer being interactable on the right of the realm screen.

Addressed an issue where joining realms and the realm list weren't functioning as expected.

We've made fixes to windowed "borderless" fullscreen mode on Windows for a smoother gaming experience.

Many other updates, bug fixes, and improvements have been made!

As always, we appreciate the feedback from our gaming community. You help us make Mythrel better with each update! Enjoy the game. See you in the realms!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.3.8
notes.content:
[b]Mythrel v0.3.8[/b]

[i][b]New Features[/b][/i]

Added new audio cues to enhance gameplay: including a new sound for last 10 seconds in Realm Matches and losing scenarios.

Our first batch of Steam Achievements are now live! Four achievements have been added:
Enter The Realm: Make a Mythrel account!
Level 5: Reach level 5 (50 Origin Wins)
Level 10: Reach level 10 (100 Origin Wins)
Level 20: Reach level 20 (200 Origin Wins)

The current number of online users is now displayed in the Codex, amongst other new features rolling out slowly.

Game server refactoring: Memory usage has been optimized for better performance.

Dragon Scale Vortex Matches has been updated. Now, you will not be debited your Dragon Scales if there is a disconnection or a player leaves the game. You will still incur losses and lose dragon scales if you concede the match.

Current time is now displayed on game screens, helping you keep track of your gaming sessions.

You must now have purchased at least 10 booster packs to be able to transfer Dragon Scales.

Added new Help option after login for new players, with links to Game Rules, Discord, How To Play, and Lore.

Additional information now in Account Settings

[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

Corrected a bug that caused the level display to show inaccurately in realm matches.

Resolved an issue causing the game feed to flicker, particularly when viewing the last card in the list.

Online users count has been updated to improved accuracy.

Fixed a bug in Codex login that occurred when entering an incorrect username.

Potential fix for in-game play of creatures getting stuck.

Backend improvements and booster pack algorithm improvements.

Deprecated/Removed Rankings screen in favor of the Mythrel Codex Rankings

Updated in-game Player Market to have a larger vertical scrollbar

Many other misc. bug fixes, typo fixes, and improvements


We hope you enjoy these improvements and fixes, there are many more on the way and we are actively listening to you the players. We appreciate all of your support and patience as Mythrel gets off the ground, please continue to share your feedback - it helps us make Mythrel better. Enjoy your gaming!

notes.title: Mythrel v0.3.7.1
notes.content:
Mythrel v0.3.7.1 Patch Notes

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

1. Deck Creation Bug for Tranquil/Origin/League Matches:

We have resolved an issue that was preventing users from creating Tranquil, Origin, and League matches with less than 2 decks. You should now be able to enter these match types regardless of the number of decks you have created.

2. Dragon's Nest Card Display Bug:

Some players were experiencing missing graphics or misnamed elements in the Dragon's Nest card display. We've investigated and resolved this issue, so you should now be able to see all the elements as they were intended.

3. Typo in Dragon Scales Transfer:

There was a typo in the warning message when transferring Dragon Scales, causing some confusion among players. We have corrected this text, making the transfer process clearer and smoother for everyone.

[b]New Features:[/b]

1. Warning for Vortex Realm Creation and Joining:

We've added a warning message that will alert players that creating or joining a Vortex Realm will consume 1 Dragon Scale. This is aimed at ensuring players make informed decisions when participating in Vortex Realm matches!

Many many more updates and improvements will be coming as time goes on! Join our community on the Discord to join the discussions!
